latest_teacher_action.diagnosis: The image preserved the presence of lions, exactly three red cats, and exactly one brown donut, but failed to make the lion count, lion material, chasing action, and cat-behind-donut relation verifiable. The six lions were not countable as six separate instances, the glass material was not clearly bound to the lions, the lions did not read as actively chasing the cats, and the cats were not clearly positioned behind the donut.
expected_improvement: Six lions should become countable by arranging them as six separated instances in two rows of three with no merging or duplicates.
The lions should be recognized as glass by explicitly making each lion transparent, reflective, and glass-bodied.
The chasing relation should be clearer by showing the six glass lions in running poses behind and moving toward the three red cats, while the cats run away.
The cats-behind-donut relation should be clearer by placing the single brown donut in the foreground and the three red cats directly behind it, still fully visible above and around the donut.
preserve_constraints: Keep lions present in the image.
Keep cats present and clearly visible.
Keep the donut present and clearly visible.

previous_plan_error.details: The prior prompt stated the needed constraints but did not impose a strongly countable layout for the six lions, did not emphasize transparent reflective glass on every lion, and left the chasing action and cats-behind-donut placement too visually ambiguous.
previous_plan_error.error_source: Prompt under-specified visual verification for persistent count, material, action, and spatial constraints.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Use a simple staged composition: one large brown donut in the foreground, exactly three red cats directly behind it but fully visible, and exactly six transparent glass lions farther behind the cats in two separated rows of three. Make all lions face and run toward the cats so the chasing relation is unambiguous, while preventing overlap that could break counts.
regression_risks: The generator may add extra lions or merge several lions into a crowd.
The transparent glass material may be lost or applied to the wrong objects.
The foreground donut may hide too much of the cats, weakening the cats-behind-donut relation.
The chase may appear static unless running poses and direction toward the cats are explicit.
The cat count or donut count could regress if extra animals or donuts appear.
repair_constraints: Show exactly six lions, not fewer and not more, with all six separated and individually countable.
Bind the glass material to every lion: each of the six lions must be transparent, reflective, glass-bodied, and visibly made of glass.
Depict the six glass lions chasing the three red cats: all lions in running pursuit poses, facing and moving toward the cats, with the cats running away from the lions.
Place the three red cats behind the single brown donut: the donut is in the foreground, and the cats are directly behind it but fully visible and not hidden.
Keep exactly three red cats, exactly one brown donut, and no extra lions, cats, or donuts.

Every lion is a transparent reflective glass-bodied lion, clearly made of glass. Keep exactly six glass lions, exactly three red cats, and exactly one brown donut. No additional lions, no additional cats, no additional donuts.
